title: Record a partial F4 census of two thin maps on the three-leaf paired star
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

On the g=3, d=2 paired-star full-call contract, exactly two thin maps are extended from F₂ to the concrete field F₄ = F₂[a]/(a²+a+1). Full calls stay the twelve F₂ resolutions. The witness condition is the polynomial identity.

Of 1,746 affine classes, 1,562 are an exhaustive F₄ proof that every point has rank sum at least 8. The commuting control meets the endpoint with ranks 4 and 4, and its F₄ minimum is exactly 8. The other 184 classes fill a frontier of 2²⁰ partial row spaces before the rank sum reaches 8. Those classes are unresolved. No completed F₄ point of rank sum 6 or 7 was returned.

Every consistent system has Zh = Zg + D for one explicit rank-4 star matrix D. This is a partial finite census. A search over F₄ leaves every larger characteristic-2 field open. The selected frontier stays κ = 781451/250000000.

## Task and overlap

Base commit: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` (canonical CrocSwap `main`).

Task card: `joint-query-controller`, scope refined. The card asks whether a changed caller or query demand removes real work. This package answers the entries-outside-F₂ question left by the F₂ two-map census, and only over the named field F₄.

Nearest overlap:

- PR #5747 is the contract and the commuting rank-8 control.
- Upstream PR #6940 and fork draft #157 settle two thin maps over F₂ and leave entries outside F₂ open. This package starts from that open question.
- Upstream PR #6922 is the one-thin census.
- Fork draft #183 changes the thin-map count to three and finds total rank 6 over F₂. This package keeps exactly two maps.
- Upstream PR #6956 changes the full-call count. This package keeps two full calls per stage.

Overlap was rechecked against open upstream PRs, discussion #5593, and the fork `cursor/*` paired-star drafts. No open item settles two thin maps over a named extension of F₂.

## Validation

`python3 -B research/paired-star-two-thin-f4/verify.py` checks the star matrix and the control maps, then compiles `search.c` and replays the census. Python 3.12, gcc, and OpenMP. The registered package command passed: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/paired-star-two-thin-f4 outcome=partial`.

Recorded counts: screened 1244160, pure hits 159984, consistent 566352, inconsistent 2793312, classes 1746, proved 1562, unresolved 184, low-rank witnesses 0. The pure product agrees with the GF(256) evaluation and with a scalar product at (2, 3, 5).

The 184 capped classes are an incomplete search, not a lower bound. F₈ and larger fields were not searched. The source-history preflight could not run because this checkout is shallow; the byte check passed at `8889385a5bbe64df6f1378047b35d89e1aea355c`.

## Credit

The contract is PR #5747. The F₂ two-map census is `cursor/paired-star-two-thin-rank-b55f`.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Independent human review and a proof-assistant proof are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

`research/paired-star-two-thin-f4/README.md` and `TASK.json`.

The smallest useful follow-up is one nullity-32 class: prove that its two Schur complements have ranks summing to at least 4, then see whether that shape covers every capped class. The frontier fills while the partial rank sum is still below 8.

The other follow-up is a single small-nullity class over F₈. A finished F₄ census would still leave that field open.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

Printing a pass token on a capped census would have hidden the 184 unresolved classes. The verifier treats that split as the result and fails if a low-rank witness appears.
